assumptions: Input is percentages, not raw counts; raw counts were reconstructed by finding the smallest sample total N for which every percentage equals round(100*k/N,2) with integer k. Bray-Curtis was computed on those counts, unstandardised.
issues: assemblages.tsv holds rounded percentages, not the raw specimen counts the task asks for. Reconstructed totals: {'P1': 48, 'P2': 310, 'P3': 125, 'P4': 77, 'P5': 402, 'P6': 190}. Candidate totals are not guaranteed unique. The palaeo_agent package only supports RMA, so it was not used.
summary: Reconstructed integer counts from percentages and computed pairwise Bray-Curtis dissimilarities.
